function.description:
Find matching lines in a page returned by search.

Returns up to 16 matching lines with line numbers and excerpts.
Use open for surrounding context. Invalid or timed-out patterns return
feedback; simplify or correct the pattern and retry.
function.name: find

pattern.description: Regular expression matched within each line, case-insensitive. Plain text matches substrings; use A|B for alternatives and \bword\b for whole words. Escape metacharacters for literal matching, e.g. 3\.14. Do not wrap the pattern in /.../.
pattern.title: Pattern

url.description: Page URL returned by search in this session.
url.title: Url

function.description:
Submit the final answer and its supporting evidence.

A valid submission ends the session; invalid submissions return feedback
for correction.
function.name: finish

answer.description: Direct, consistent answer supported by retrieved evidence. If evidence is insufficient, explain what remains unknown.
answer.title: Answer

sources.description: URLs of pages whose content supports the answer, including intermediate facts needed to derive it. Rank by relevance, include each URL once, and exclude pages that did not contribute supporting evidence. Use only URLs returned by retrieval tools in this session. Use an empty list if no supporting evidence was found.
sources.title: Sources

function.description:
Read up to 16 lines from a page returned by search, starting at loc.

Choose any starting line to inspect a passage or continue reading.
function.name: open

loc.description: Zero-based starting line. Omit or use null to start at line 0.
loc.title: Loc

url.description: Page URL returned by search in this session.
url.title: Url

function.description:
Search the corpus. Returns up to 5 relevant pages with URLs, titles, and snippets.

Use open or find to inspect the supporting evidence.
function.name: search
